findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Pre-capture interruption still allows a handed spend to disappear on checkpoint replacement
findings.smallest reproduction: Start following reader with live ledger mapping; dispatch once and settle run. Interrupt _retain_handing both on initial capture and immediate recovery before account references are retained. Replace mapping entry with the pre-spend owner checkpoint. Next pin recovers the now-restored mapping and dispatch can recur. No private account mutation is needed.
findings.actual result: Static path: _uncompared retains the original live mapping at 999; recovery at 920/939 rereads it later. Restored contents can clear pending recovery without retaining the spend. The preserved R16 REPAIR/open-capture.log reports the expected refusal assertion failing. NOT RUN by this reviewer.
findings.expected result: Unavailable handed history must not become acceptance after restore; an honest interruption alone must not permanently poison the reader.
findings.proposed correction: Keep this OPEN. Select an owner handoff lifetime/publication contract retaining canonical snapshots or histories through acknowledgement, including restore, interruption and multiple-reader rules. Do not silently narrow observation to successful capture. Local sentinel registration and retry improvements reduce specific gaps but cannot recover contents already lost.

findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Retained normalization still omits the ordinary owner JSON round trip
findings.smallest reproduction: Use an empty BudgetLedger(100), following reader, then settle a new charge with detail={2: "a", 10: "b"}; interrupt after native mapping retention via _handed once, so recovery retains the charge. Supply an honest BudgetLedger.from_dict(account.to_dict()) detached checkpoint, then read the ledger.
findings.actual result: Static derivation: BudgetCharge.from_dict retains detail unchanged (budget.py:130), settle accepts it (321). Retained _history sorts integer detail keys as 2,10. Ordinary _read_once (497-501) serializes and JSON-decodes before hashing, making the keys strings; _history now sorts them as "10","2". Different hashes for unchanged owner-readable content cause permanent _diverged at 807-811. NOT EXECUTED; independent executable confirmation requested from parent.
findings.expected result: Owner-readable unchanged detached checkpoints normalize identically and recover without evidence of rewritten history.
findings.proposed correction: Use the complete existing owner serialization/read-back sequence for retained history, including its JSON transformation, before hashing. Add a deterministic numeric-key JSON transformation control alongside iteration normalization; retain rejection of truly incompatible histories. Do not tighten accepted owner payload types in the follower.
